result: The notoriously violent territory of the Kolar Gold Fields now rests under the control of a relentless new ruler, Rocky. His mere name commands terror among those who dare to oppose him, yet to his loyal supporters, he stands as a beacon of hope and a true savior. Establishing his firm reign over this blood-drenched region, Rocky becomes a powerful figure around whom loyalty and fierce opposition revolve.

However, maintaining control over his empire proves to be a dangerous endeavor. While the government officially views Rocky as a major threat to law and order, his vengeful enemies gather in the shadows, actively scheming to bring about his downfall. As Rocky aggressively pushes forward in his pursuit of unchallenged supremacy, he must face even darker days and increasingly bloodier battles.
